note: Which things in the tower prompt which sung thought of Model B's inner voice (commons/void/inner_opera.gd). By map name, then by row id or prop id on that floor; the value is an object_id of a phrase in the score. `renderer` is airway (audio/generators/AirwayVoice.gd: the physical voice, the one that was approved; slow to make, so its phrases travel with the game in audio/voice_cache/, written by the bench's KEEP), model_b (audio/generators/ModelBVoice.gd, a quick formant voice) or robot (the kit's RobotVoiceGenerator.gd); `voice` holds that renderer's settings; `volume_db` is the voice's level in the head. First study, 2026-11-16: the roof only.
